#### REVENUE

## E-Commerce

Give guests an easy way to discover and buy tickets, experiences, F&B, merchandise or upgrades from their phone,  
 whether they’re planning ahead or deciding what they want next while already inside the venue.

[Book a Demo](http://vantage.co/request-a-demo/ "Request A Demo")

### MORE WAYS TO SPEND

## Create More Opportunities to Add to the Day

**For guests:** Easily discover, purchase and add to their experience without having to visit a service desk.

**For operators:** Capture more revenue, promote add-ons and make it easier for guests to spend without adding more work for frontline teams.

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IEVTe0JE6dg)

![Image 4](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/4-1.png)

### Connected Commerce

## Keep the Opportunity to Purchase Open

Respond to Demand in Real Time

Keep what guests see aligned with what’s actually available. Update inventory, availability and offerings as demand changes throughout the day, helping your team promote what you have capacity for and capture more revenue from available experiences and products.

Make Your Offers More Relevant

Use what you know about each guest to surface more relevant products, upgrades and experiences. Personalized recommendations create natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell while helping guests discover additions that make sense for their visit.

Increase Convenience to Increase Spend

Give guests an easy way to browse and purchase tickets, upgrades, experiences, F&B and merchandise directly from their phone. They can add to their day whenever the opportunity arises, without finding a service desk, joining another line or interrupting what they’re already doing.

### How It Works

## Sell Beyond the Initial Booking

### Guests Browse

Guests explore upgrades, F&B, and other add-ons directly from their phones, reducing reliance on frontline teams to manage upgrades and additional purchases.

### Up-to-Date Inventory

What guests see can reflect availability, inventory and where they are in their visit, keeping purchase options relevant to the moment.

### Personalize the Experience

Surface relevant products and add-ons based on guest information and activity, creating more natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell.

### Guest Purchases

Guests can buy or upgrade directly from their device without visiting a service desk or interrupting their day.

### One Guest Profile

Transactions become part of the connected guest profile, giving operators a clearer picture of how each guest spends and engages.

### Adjust Store

Use purchasing and guest behaviour to understand what’s working, adjust offerings and create more relevant opportunities throughout the rest of the visit.

### Explore FEATURES

## More Ways to Boost  
 the Guest Experience

[![Image 5](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Push-Notifications-1024x576.png)](https://vantage.co/smartnotify-personalized-push-notification/)

Drive traffic and increase F&B sales with targeted timely promotions.

#### Gamification

Turn casual visitors into enthusiastic regulars with your personalized rewards engine.

[Learn More](https://vantage.co/myperks-loyalty-and-gamification-program/)

[![Image 7](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/2-1-1024x576.png)](https://vantage.co/smartvue-2/)

#### Real-Time Reporting

Gain a bird’s-eye view to optimize staffing and inventory based on predictive analytics.

[Learn More](https://vantage.co/smartvue-2/)

[![Image 8](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/VATNTAGE-SA-ZOO-15-1-1024x683.jpg)](https://vantage.co/smartcontrol-access-control/)

#### Access Control

Empower your guests with frictionless access while your team enjoys streamlined operations.

[Learn More](https://vantage.co/smartcontrol-access-control/)

[![Image 9](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Vantage-at-San-Antonio-Zoo-SmartPay-1536x864-1-1024x576.jpg)](https://vantage.co/smartpay-cashless-payment/)

#### Cashless Payments

Implement cashless payments for faster transactions and increased spending.

#### REVENUE

## E-Commerce

Give guests an easy way to discover and buy tickets, experiences, F&B, merchandise or upgrades from their phone,  
 whether they’re planning ahead or deciding what they want next while already inside the venue.

[Book a Demo](http://vantage.co/request-a-demo/ "Request A Demo")

### MORE WAYS TO SPEND

## Create More Opportunities to Add to the Day

**For guests:** Easily discover, purchase and add to their experience without having to visit a service desk.

**For operators:** Capture more revenue, promote add-ons and make it easier for guests to spend without adding more work for frontline teams.

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IEVTe0JE6dg)

![Image 4](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/4-1.png)

### Connected Commerce

## Keep the Opportunity to Purchase Open

Respond to Demand in Real Time

Keep what guests see aligned with what’s actually available. Update inventory, availability and offerings as demand changes throughout the day, helping your team promote what you have capacity for and capture more revenue from available experiences and products.

Make Your Offers More Relevant

Use what you know about each guest to surface more relevant products, upgrades and experiences. Personalized recommendations create natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell while helping guests discover additions that make sense for their visit.

Increase Convenience to Increase Spend

Give guests an easy way to browse and purchase tickets, upgrades, experiences, F&B and merchandise directly from their phone. They can add to their day whenever the opportunity arises, without finding a service desk, joining another line or interrupting what they’re already doing.

### How It Works

## Sell Beyond the Initial Booking

### Guests Browse

Guests explore upgrades, F&B, and other add-ons directly from their phones, reducing reliance on frontline teams to manage upgrades and additional purchases.

### Up-to-Date Inventory

What guests see can reflect availability, inventory and where they are in their visit, keeping purchase options relevant to the moment.

### Personalize the Experience

Surface relevant products and add-ons based on guest information and activity, creating more natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell.

### Guest Purchases

Guests can buy or upgrade directly from their device without visiting a service desk or interrupting their day.

### One Guest Profile

Transactions become part of the connected guest profile, giving operators a clearer picture of how each guest spends and engages.

### Adjust Store

Use purchasing and guest behaviour to understand what’s working, adjust offerings and create more relevant opportunities throughout the rest of the visit.
